changes: p2 Bhāgīrāma: removed role 'governor'; kept 'minister' (pramāna = Malla court office, 'X-yā velasa' = 'in the time of X'); title normalized to 'pramāna (paramāna)'
p2 confidence lowered to medium: the role reading conflicts with the catalogue, which lists him as scribe
ce_approx changed from 1690 to 1689: NS 810 began in Kārtika 1689, so Kārtika śukla 9 of NS 810 falls in Oct/Nov 1689 CE

notes: The colophon says King (Sumati-Jaya-)Jitāmitra Malla of Bhaktapur had the book made ('dayakā'). It names no scribe. 'bhāgirāmaparamānayā velasa' means 'in the time of Bhāgīrāma the pramāna (court official/minister)', so the catalogue is probably wrong to call Bhāgīrāma the scribe. Kārtika śukla 9 of NS 810 falls in the first weeks of that year, so it is October/November 1689 CE.
